claims.proves: the existing skill entrypoint exits with the expected status and the Ask reviewer-window placement commands remain registered
claims.does_not_prove: semantic correctness, live service behavior, or full skill readiness

cases.name: ask-reviewer-window-placement-commands-are-registered
command: cd .. && ./run.sh window-snapshot --help >/tmp/browser-oracle-window-snapshot-help.txt && ./run.sh place-window --help >/tmp/browser-oracle-place-window-help.txt && grep -q 'List current Chrome/X11 window ids' /tmp/browser-oracle-window-snapshot-help.txt && grep -q 'Move exactly one newly-created Chrome window' /tmp/browser-oracle-place-window-help.txt && echo REVIEWER_WINDOW_PLACEMENT_COMMANDS_REGISTERED
